job.text: Look up what share of the aggressive portfolio is at each level of risk

title.text: Aggressive Portfolio by Risk Level, Dec. 31, 2022

source.notes: 00-01 F3; 13-15 F10 (the aggressive portfolio's data, s. 0020, 0368); 07 R7-35
source.shows: ours, from the book's data, which it draws as 100 % stacks: one total of ordered parts as a pie, the risk levels in their own order from 12 o'clock rather than largest first (R7-35, G7.28), in steps of one hue, the first the darkest, rather than a hue each (G4.7, R3-8), as the book's good stacks (P3-34); Very low risk, under 8°, pointed to by a leader (G7.29)
the risk levels taken as unordered parts: largest first, a hue each, the order of risk lost, as in the book's bad version (s. 0020) with its Office colours
